body.name: Internal separate-posterior-pair outer relaxation
body.construction: \(L_{\mathrm{sep}}=\sum_x\lambda_x\{\min_{D_{A,x}}q^-_{1,x}-\max_{D_{A,x}}q^+_{0,x}\}\) and \(R_{\mathrm{sep}}=\sum_x\lambda_x\{\max_{D_{A,x}}q^+_{1,x}-\min_{D_{A,x}}q^-_{0,x}\}\), where the two extrema within braces may use different posterior pairs; \(\mathcal I_{\mathrm{sep}}=[L_{\mathrm{sep}},R_{\mathrm{sep}}]\).  This is an internal outer relaxation of the common-binary-confounder class, not a published marginal-sensitivity model.
